subject: POC plan, success criteria & RACI for FinApp trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0500
Subject: POC plan, success criteria & RACI for FinApp trial

Alex — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick written recap + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the trial.

Summary of what we discussed:
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for FinApp’s fraud-detection assistant (low-latency ranking + embeddings for similarity search).
- Success criteria (you confirmed):
  * P95 latency <= 180ms for 512-token requests under expected load,
  * End-to-end FN/FP performance within 5% of your current baseline on the 10k eval set,
  * Embed search recall >= 92% at 100ms average embedding time,
  * No sensitive data is persisted beyond cached inference keys (in-scope for security review).
- High-level POC scope: 3-week evaluation — week 1 integration + smoke tests, week 2 load & perf tuning, week 3 user QA + final metrics review.

Ownership (proposed):
- Customer infra (VPC, network config): Alex / Priya (FinApp IT) — action: provide CIDR & firewall details.
- App integration (API calls, client SDK): FinApp app team (primary) / Redwood SE (Connor) — action: small integration sample + SDK snippet.
- Security/compliance review: FinApp security (Priya) + Redwood security (Vivek) — action: questionnaire + SOC2 evidence.
- Procurement & contracting: FinApp procurement (Priya) / Redwood commercial (me).

Immediate open items for the POC checklist:
1) FinApp to confirm network egress policy and whether a private link is required (owners: Priya / Marissa).
2) We will provide an initial POC image and quickstart docs by EOD Friday (owner: Connor).
3) Security questionnaire — we attached the latest template; please flag anything missing (owner: Priya).
4) Define one production-like evaluation set (10k records) and the root metric for go/no-go (owner: Alex).

Attachments: POC_Scope_v2.pdf, FinApp_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (see attached stubs)

Proposed slots for kick-off call: Thu 26 Feb 10:00-11:00 ET or Fri 27 Feb 09:00-10:00 ET — please pick one.

Thanks — I’ll update the shared MAP doc after we confirm the items above.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:24:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC plan, success criteria & RACI for FinApp trial

Thanks Marissa — a couple of technical clarifications from the SE side so we size the environment correctly: 

1) Traffic profile: can you confirm expected RPS and average sequence length for the inference calls during the load week? If not available, a 100–300 RPS range is reasonable to size initial capacity.

2) Data residency: will any of the payloads include PII that needs to be redacted client-side before sending? If so, we need to add a short pre-processing step in the sample integration.

3) RACI suggestion (technical):
- Integrations: R=FinApp app team, A=Connor O'Brien (Redwood SE), C=Marissa Cole, I=Vivek Kulkarni
- Infra/network: R=FinApp IT (Priya), A=Priya Singh, C=Connor O'Brien, I=Marissa Cole
- Security/compliance: R=Priya Singh (FinApp), A=Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood), C=Marissa Cole, I=Tessa Morgan
- Procurement/contract: R=Priya Singh (FinApp), A=Marissa Cole (Redwood), C=Vivek Kulkarni

I’ll draft the minimal runbook for the POC environment (endpoints, sample payloads, test harness) and drop it in the shared MAP doc by EOD Thursday. Also will include the specific performance counters we’ll track (latency percentiles, tokens/s, error rates).

—Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finapp.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC plan, success criteria & RACI for FinApp trial

Marissa / Connor — thanks for the detailed breakdown. Priya and I reviewed internally and we’re aligned on the majority of the scope. Responses below and a couple of small edits to the owners: 

Confirmed success criteria:
- P95 latency <= 180ms under target load (we’ll share a short load profile this afternoon).
- End-to-end model performance within 5% of our baseline on the 10k eval set — we’ll hand over the eval set by Monday.
- Embed search recall >= 92% — agreed.

POC ownership updates (FinApp side):
- Network/infra owner: Priya Singh (FinApp IT) — will provide CIDR and proxy details by EOD Friday.
- App integration owner: Me (Alex) — I’ll coordinate with our backend engineer (Samir) to run the integration work.
- Security reviewer: Monica Lopez (info.sec@finapp.com) — she’ll own the security questionnaire; I copied Priya who’ll coordinate the logistics.
- Procurement: Priya Singh will lead contracting & purchase order.

Attachments: I attached an internal security contact list and the initial eval dataset checklist (referenced; stubs attached).

Timeline: the 3-week window works. We prefer a kick-off on Thu 26 Feb 10:00 ET if that works for Redwood (slot confirmed).

A couple of asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a short test harness (curl + Node snippet) that we can use to validate network connectivity quickly?
2) During the load week, can Redwood expose token-level cost reporting per route so we can correlate ops spend to queries?

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

—Alex
Director, Product — FinApp Inc.
alex.johnson@finapp.com | +1 (212) 555-0134

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finapp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC plan, success criteria & RACI for FinApp trial — Kickoff confirmed

Great — Thu 26 Feb 10:00 ET works (we’ll mark as confirmed). Quick follow-ups and next steps before the kick-off so we hit the ground running: 

Action list and owners (updated):
- FinApp: provide CIDR/firewall rules + decision on private link (owner: Priya) — due: Fri 27 Feb EOD (you flagged Friday; if delayed we can proceed with public endpoints + IP allowlist).
- FinApp: share the 10k eval set + any labeling notes (owner: Alex) — due: Mon 2 Mar.
- Redwood: provide quickstart test harness (curl + Node) and initial Docker image for the POC (owner: Connor) — due: Fri 27 Feb EOD (attached as stub in MAP).
- Redwood Security: complete security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence pointer (owner: Vivek) — initial turnaround: Mon 2 Mar.
- Redwood Commercial: draft short SOW + pricing guardrails for POC (owner: Marissa) — due: Mon 2 Mar; will include PO instructions if you want to initiate procurement early.

Success metrics we will track during the POC:
- Latency percentiles (P50/P95/P99), tokens/sec, error-rate, model-accuracy delta vs your baseline.
- Embedding throughput and 90/95/99 recall checkpoints.

Logistics: I’ll add the updated MAP doc here: https://docs.redwood.ai/shared/POC-MAP-FINAPP and link the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FIN-2026-034).

Attachments included: POC_Scope_v2.pdf (detailed MAP), FinApp_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (filled in where we could).

If there are no objections to owners/timelines we’ll move these into the MAP and start work. Thanks everyone — see you on the kickoff.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
